statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail rises from 10 to 16 as NQ turns back down toward the session low, but stays well inside the low band because the price path remains two-way. NQ trades 29,403.50 against a 29,538.75 settle, 70 points above the 29,333.25 low, after having fully retraced that down leg to a 29,633.75 session high earlier in the cash session. The cross-asset backdrop has hardened: VIX at 16.58 and the 10-year at 4.849% are both at session highs, with Brent $101.39 and WTI $96.55 up more than 3.5% on US-Iran escalation around the Strait of Hormuz. Stress rises to 83 and stays extreme, because that is a demanding environment rather than an observed failure of mean reversion.
recommendation: Tail at 16 maps to EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD and remains below the block threshold. The danger window stays at 17:00-18:00 UTC, where the US 10-year note auction and the Apple 'Surprise and Shine' keynote coincide with a 10-year yield at a session-high 4.849%; the conditional forecast lifts tail to 19 in that hour and holds 17 in the hour after it. The highest conditional reading in the 24-hour window is 18 at 12:00 UTC on 10 September for August PPI, Core PPI and initial jobless claims. No forecast hour reaches the watch band. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by the mapped state.
headline: NQ gives back its recovery to trade 29,403.50, 70 points off the 29,333.25 low, as VIX 16.58 and the 10-year 4.849% set session highs on $101 Brent; tail lifts to 16 on a still two-way path
body:
The session has now produced a complete round trip in both directions. NQ opened at 29,614.50, sold off to a 29,333.25 low around the 13:30 UTC cash open, retraced the whole 281-point distance to a 29,633.75 session high, and has since given that recovery back to trade at 29,403.50, down 0.46% against a 29,538.75 settle. Investing.com corroborates the same structure at 29,393.75 on an identical 29,333.00 low and 29,633.75 high. The NASDAQ-100 cash index sits at 29,349.35, down 0.54% from a 29,507.70 close, inside a 29,334.40 to 29,563.60 range and near the lower end of it.

What has changed since the previous hour is the cross-asset picture, not the price structure. VIX at 16.58 is up 5.49% and is printing at its session high, having taken out the 16.56 level that capped it earlier. The 10-year at 4.849% is up 4.3 basis points on a 4.806% close and is also at its session high, above the 4.818% that held earlier and at the highest level since November 2023. The 2-year at roughly 4.43% is up about 2.6 basis points, so the move is led by the long end. Brent trades at $101.39, up 3.54%, and WTI at $96.55, up 3.78%, after US and Iranian forces exchanged strikes on tankers around the Strait of Hormuz. That is three independent amplifiers pointing the same way at the same time.

The distinction that governs the score is between a difficult environment and a denied-retracement path. The amplifier stack argues for a higher reading than the 10 published an hour ago, and tail moves up to 16. It does not argue for the watch band, because the observed price path is the opposite of one-way: a 300-point range with a full retracement up and then a substantial retracement back down is exactly the two-way structure a reverse or grid approach needs, and NQ has not broken the 29,333.25 low that has now been tested twice. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks is not present, and the index is not holding near an extreme.

The danger window is unchanged at 17:00-18:00 UTC. The US 10-year note auction, which last awarded at 4.683%, arrives with the 10-year 17 basis points higher than that, and Apple's 'Surprise and Shine' keynote starts in the same hour. A poorly received auction is the single credible mechanism on today's calendar for a delayed, yield-led second leg, so conditional tail rises to 19 there and holds 17 through the digestion hour. The Apple event is treated as single-name dispersion rather than index-level structure.

Beyond today, the overnight stretch from 21:00 UTC to 05:00 UTC carries 8 to 9 with no scheduled US catalyst, where the residual risk is a Middle East supply headline gapping a thin book rather than a developing trend. The highest conditional reading in the window is 18 at 12:00 UTC on 10 September, when August PPI, Core PPI and initial jobless claims print together at 12:30 UTC against consensus of 0.0% headline PPI, 0.2% core and 206K claims, with energy pass-through into producer prices the tail-relevant channel. Confidence is 87 on live corroborated futures, cash-index, volatility, yield and commodity levels drawn from independent primary sources; the shared cross-asset context file was more than three hours old at assessment time and was therefore treated as stale and excluded.
lookbackSummary: Across the 24 clock-hours from 15:00 UTC on 8 September to 14:00 UTC on 9 September the mapped state was EA_ON in every published hour except 12:00 UTC on 9 September, which was WATCH. Tail ran between 5 and 20. It sat between 5 and 9 for nineteen of the twenty-three published hours, then broke higher through the European morning: 15 at 11:00 UTC as the overnight band gave way, a peak of 20 at 12:00 UTC as the session low extended to 29,333.25, 17 at 13:00 UTC as the first retracement appeared, and 10 at 14:00 UTC once the entire down leg had been recovered. One hour, 10:00 UTC on 9 September, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable. The clearest trend in the window is stress, which climbed almost without interruption from 68 at 17:00 UTC on 8 September to 83 at 12:00 UTC on 9 September as crude advanced through $99 and then above $100 and the 10-year reached its highest level in nearly three years, easing only briefly to 80 before returning to 81. Dominant mode was mixed in twenty hours, normal in one and trend-down in two, the trend-down readings clustering in the two hours of the overnight break. Confidence held in a narrow 87 to 89 band throughout.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours contain one high-impact US release cluster: August PPI, Core PPI and initial jobless claims at 12:30 UTC on 10 September, which falls inside the third-to-last forecast slot. August CPI on 11 September and the 16 September FOMC decision sit outside the window. Conditional tail runs in an 8 to 19 band and never reaches the watch band, so every one of the 24 slots maps to EA_ON. The path peaks at 19 inside the published 17:00-18:00 UTC danger window, where the US 10-year note auction and the Apple keynote coincide with a 10-year yield at a session-high 4.849% and a weak auction is the one credible route to a delayed yield-led second leg, and at 18 for the PPI and claims hour. The overnight stretch from 21:00 UTC to 05:00 UTC carries 8 to 9 with no scheduled US catalyst, where the residual risk is a Middle East supply headline gapping the thin Globex book. Conditional stress eases from 83 to about 75 overnight and rebuilds to 85 into the PPI release, on the assumption that the energy backdrop persists. Confidence decays from 87 to 74 across the window, which reflects the shrinking value of current price-path evidence rather than any expected deterioration in conditions.
